chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Ibrahim ibn Mihzan, from Talha ibn Zayd, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to break his fast on dates during the season of dates, and on fresh dates during the season of fresh dates.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) use to break his fast according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the Prophet’s (SAWW) adherence to seasonal availability, distinguishing between dry dates (tamr) and fresh dates (rutab) for iftar. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on following the Sunnah while adapting to local agricultural contexts, reflecting a balance between ritual tradition and practical wisdom. It serves as a foundational text for the recommended etiquette of breaking the fast, linking physical nourishment with spiritual mindfulness.
